preconditions.description: The number of queries Q is between 1 and 400000 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(0 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= 10**18 and 0 <= int(line.split()[2]) <= 10**18 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: Each query has two integers p and q between 0 and 10^18 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all((line.split()[0] == '1' and 0 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= cnt and 0 <= int(line.split()[2]) <= 10**9) or (line.split()[0] == '2' and 0 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= cnt and 0 <= int(line.split()[2]) <= 10**15) for cnt, line in enumerate(stdin.splitlines()[1:], start=1))
postconditions.description: Each type 1 query has R between 1 and cnt inclusive and W between 0 and 10^9 inclusive. Each type 2 query has R between 1 and cnt inclusive and X between 0 and 10^15 inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(line.split()[0] in ['1', '2'] for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:])
postconditions.description: Each query is either of type 1 or type 2.

postconditions.expression: len(stdout.splitlines()) == sum(1 for line in stdin.splitlines()[1:] if line.split()[0] == '2')
postconditions.description: The number of output lines is equal to the number of type 2 queries.
